---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new idea or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you're requesting.

## 🔧 Problem It Solves

What problem does this feature solve? What's the use case?

e.g. "I'm always frustrated when I try to do X and Y happens..."

## 📐 Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📸 Mockups / Examples

If applicable, add screenshots, sketches, or links to similar features in other apps.

## 📝 Additional Context

Any other context, links, or references.
